What does carpet stretching cost in Everett?

A power stretcher hooks the carpet and pulls it tight against the tack strip, taking out the buckles, waves and trip edges that build up in a hallway between tenants. Priced from $99 a room in Everett, that's around a fifth of what new carpet costs — worth doing any time the pile hasn't gone flat and the color still suits you.

What's the best carpet for a house with pets?

Odor becomes permanent when urine reaches the subfloor, not when it hits the fiber. So the pet answer has two parts: a sealed backing over a moisture-barrier pad to stop the soak, and solution-dyed nylon on top, its color built into the fiber so it survives diluted bleach. Everett rentals turn over fast and get this pairing most. Upgrading to that barrier pad starts at $0.65 per square foot; both ride in the van.
